items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 73:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the revealed masculine power? The aspect of Joseph in the Yesod of ZA is the revealed masculine power in ZA, which is the aspect of the direct light in the stature, namely the power of revelation that comes through the coupling.
